contract: Map a 12-bit offset-binary sample (0..4095) to signed counts with zero at 2048.
defect: The XOR moves the midpoint; the subsequent bias produces the wrong zero.

contract: Given a previous and current 16-bit tick counter, return elapsed ticks modulo 65536. At most one wrap occurs.
before: return now >= prev ? (uint32_t)now - prev : 65536u - prev + now;

contract: Return centidegrees rounded to the nearest whole degree; exact half degrees round away from zero. Input is -12500..12500.
defect: Adding 50 before truncation is incorrect for negative samples.

contract: Return 1 to retry an unavailable read (ok=0), at most twice after the original attempt. retries is the number of retries already made, 0..2.
Latch a high-temperature alarm at 80 C or above. Once latched, keep it active until temperature falls strictly below 75 C. old is 0 or 1.
defect: A previously active alarm clears one degree early at exactly 75 C.

contract: Replace bits 5..4 of an 8-bit status register with lane (0..3) and preserve every other bit.
On a valid byte sample (valid=1), replace the previous value, including a zero measurement. On a failed read keep the previous value.
signature: uint8_t update_sample(uint8_t prev, uint8_t sample, int valid)
defect: It discards a valid zero sample and returns the previous measurement.

contract: Return the mean of two unsigned 16-bit readings, rounded down. All input pairs are valid.
